newsitem.title: UKRAINE: McDonald's first Ukraine opening May 1997.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's first Ukraine opening May 1997.

text.p: U.S. hamburger giant McDonald's Corp will open its first Ukrainian restaurant in 1997 and six more outlets will follow in a $10 million investment, operations manager Wilbert Husselman said on Monday.
"We are convinced that McDonald's can be a very big success in Ukraine," Husselman told Reuters. "The potential is enormous...We are looking at roughly $10 million" in investment.
He said all seven restaurants would be set up in Kiev.
Husselman said McDonald's had waited to see how Ukraine's economy evolved before starting operations.
"Basically we waited until we were convinced there was political and economic stability in Ukraine," he said.
The firm has several Russian restaurants.
